notes: "Reuse needs two modes. By default a Presentation shows the live Main Slide, which is what you want for most corrections. Sometimes a talk must stay exactly as it was, for example the version you sent to a committee. Then you record a named version of that slide and pin the appearance to it. The pinned appearance cannot be edited from that talk, and later Main edits do not touch it. The strip at the bottom is the real header above the canvas: it counts live and pinned references before you make a change, so the reach of an edit is never a surprise."

designIntent.purpose: Contrast live reuse with an explicitly pinned named version.
